Clean_Rate_bpm: Description
Treatment Start - Rig up verified and data acquisition started
Open Well - Master valve opened and wellhead equalized
Start Pumping - Pumps engaged on freshwater
Spot Acid - 15% HCl acid spotted to perforations
Acid Stage - Pumping 15% HCl spearhead acid stage
Pump Acid - Main acid injection into formation
Flush Acid - Displacing acid past perforations with slickwater
Breakdown - Formation breakdown pressure peak reached
Break Formation - Fracture initiated and pressure propagating
Pad - Pumping linear gel pad volume to create fracture geometry
5-minute (300s) DAQ telemetry dropout during Pad stage (10:30:00Z - 10:34:59Z)
Ball on Seat - Diverting ball seated with pressure spike
PLF Stage 1 - Proppant-laden fluid stage at 0.5 ppg
PLF Stage 2 - Proppant-laden fluid stage at 1.0 ppg
PLF Stage 3 - Proppant-laden fluid stage at 1.5 ppg
5-minute (300s) DAQ telemetry dropout during PLF Stage 3 at 1.5 ppg (11:15:00Z - 11:19:59Z)
PLF Stage 4 - Proppant-laden fluid stage at 2.0 ppg
PLF Stage 5 - Proppant-laden fluid stage at 2.5 ppg
5-minute (300s) DAQ telemetry dropout during PLF Stage 5 at 2.5 ppg (12:05:00Z - 12:09:59Z)
Flush - Clean fluid flush to clear wellbore of proppant
Stop Pumping - Pumps shut down and ISIP observed
Terminate Treatment - Well shut in and job completed
